description: A sheet of paper sits on the desk with a small green watercolor patch, and nearby are a cup of water with a brush inside, a watercolor palette, a clear pen-like tool, and some folded tissues. The left hand rests on the paper to steady it while the right hand holds the paint brush, reaches to the water cup to rinse the bristles, then dabs and wipes the brush on the tissues before moving back toward the palette and paper to continue painting.
